title: CutReview v1
description: A reviewable, non-destructive analysis of a recorded take. Every transcript segment is listed in time order with a suggested action (KEEP, REVIEW, CUT), a human-readable reason and a confidence. CUT is only a suggestion; the cut decision stays human. Produced by the `review-cuts` CLI from a local transcription plus silence detection; no media is removed and no render is performed at this stage.

duration.description: Total take length as MM:SS (minutes may exceed two digits).

reason.description: Why the segment is flagged; empty string for KEEP.

confidence.description: Strength of the cut signal; 0 for KEEP.
